notes.title: ORBITAL BATTLE is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Commanders, are you ready to dive into the world of ORBITAL BATTLE?
This is a real-time strategy game that blends resource management, strategic planning, and defense elements. Build and strengthen your base, allocate resources wisely, deploy train transportation systems, and fend off relentless enemy attacks to claim victory!

Launch Discount: 20% off for a limited time
Languages Supported: Chinese, English, Japanese
